recipe.variant: LacklusterOpsec fork, v1.1 weights, 4x, mode full (Wan 2.1 VAE decode), bf16, sparse_sage_attention, no tiling, no chunking: the 24 GB+ row of the pack's VRAM table
recipe.from_template: No Comfy-Org local template exists (the only one, api_wavespeed_flshvsr_video_upscale, is a paid API node and excluded). Graph as the pack README documents: LoadVideo -> GetVideoComponents -> FlashVSRInitPipe -> FlashVSRNodeAdv -> CreateVideo -> SaveVideo; values are the README's 24 GB+ VRAM row over the nodes.py defaults.
recipe.min_comfyui_note: NOT FOUND (neither pack states a ComfyUI minimum); the native spine nodes exist in v0.35.0
recipe.confidence_note: the pack's own README + nodes.py + CHANGELOG (official for the pack) and the upstream lihaoyun6 README it forks, which documents the same node ids and parameters: two sources

scale.note: 2-4; official: 4x is the trained setting ('strongly recommend'), 2x only as a VRAM concession

mode.note: tiny (TCDecoder, fast) | tiny-long (streams, 'significantly reduce VRAM used with long video input') | full (Wan VAE decode, higher quality)

vae_model.note: Wan2.1 (default) | Wan2.2 | LightVAE_W2.1 ('50% less VRAM') | TAE_W2.2 | LightTAE_HY1.5; auto-downloaded from lightx2v/Autoencoders

precision.note: fp16 | bf16 | fp8_e4m3fn ('cuts VRAM in half', PyTorch 2.1+ and Ada/Hopper) | auto (node default)

attention_mode.note: sparse_sage_attention (sm_75-sm_120) | block_sparse_attention (sm_80-sm_100, official backend) | flash_attention_2 | sdpa | sage_attention_2; keep a SPARSE backend for quality parity

force_offload.note: offload all weights to CPU after the run

tiled_vae.note: lower memory at the cost of speed

tiled_dit.note: 'Significantly reduces VRAM usage at the cost of speed'

unload_dit.note: unload the DiT before decoding to cut the VRAM peak (slower); the simple node defaults it True 'Recommended for 16GB VRAM'

frame_chunk_size.note: 0 = all frames; N = process in chunks of N frames to prevent OOM (README table: 50-100 at 16 GB, 50 at 12 GB, 16-32 at 8 GB)

color_fix.note: wavelet colour transfer to the source; keep True

resize_factor.note: 0.1-1.0 pre-shrink of the input before upscaling

video.note: the clip to upscale; frames go to the FlashVSR node, fps and audio pass from GetVideoComponents to CreateVideo. FlashVSR is a streaming model: feed a clip (>= 21 frames), not a still.

recipe.files_note: the four files of the JunhaoZhuang/FlashVSR-v1.1 HF repo, downloaded as-is into ComfyUI/models/FlashVSR/ (the node's `model` option names the version folder); the exact subfolder layout the pack expects: NOT FOUND, follow the pack README. The fixed prompt embedding (posi_prompt.pth) ships inside the node repo.
recipe.packs_note: do NOT install together with lihaoyun6/ComfyUI-FlashVSR_Ultra_Fast: both register FlashVSRNode / FlashVSRNodeAdv / FlashVSRInitPipe (class-id collision). Optional deps: Sparse_SageAttention (Triton), flash_attn, xformers, torchao; model_paths.yaml key flashvsr_model_path.
recipe.defaults_note: 4x, full mode, Wan2.1 VAE, bf16, sparse_sage_attention, tiling off, chunking off (24 GB+ row). No text prompt: the fixed positive embedding (posi_prompt.pth) ships with the pack. Keep color_fix on.

vram_evidence.at: mode full/tiny, VAE Wan2.1/Wan2.2, tiling disabled, frame_chunk_size 0, bf16
vram_evidence.usage: NOT FOUND (no measured number; the table gives settings per VRAM class). Official paper figure: ~17 FPS at 768x1408 on one A100 with the reference implementation, not this pack
